response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with strong web, testing, and open-source credentials, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems/compute platform work; his C/C++ exposure is limited to roughly 6 months at National Instruments in 2015 plus a university thesis project, and C++ does not appear in his listed skills. His systems-level work is largely in DLang and Node.js, and while the Sociomantic/Dunnhumby role involved high-throughput microservices, that is a single ~2-year stint rather than sustained cloud compute platform ownership. He also lacks explicit formal technical-leadership or mentoring-of-cloud-engineers experience, though he has notable community teaching and workshop activity. Fit would be far better for a senior backend/full-stack or developer-tooling role.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering career across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency backend systems
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, own test tooling libraries) and proven mentoring via workshops and courses
Real high-throughput distributed experience at Sociomantic (millions of HTTP req/s, async I/O, caching) plus Kubernetes/Docker/AWS exposure
concerns: Far short of 8 years C++; only ~6 months of professional C/C++ and not listed among skills
No production cloud compute platform architecture or hardware/storage/compute-infrastructure ownership
No formal technical lead role managing priorities, roadmaps, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/compute infrastructure ownership
Seniority, breadth, and mentoring track record
